record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare BARED_FANGS: Basculin Blue and Basculin Red, both 3 stars, maxPP 80, range 1, passive BASCULIN_RED_BLUE (the passive is not described here). Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Single-target. Deals SPECIAL damage to the cast target (requested round(caster's current ATK x 1.6) at 3 stars; multiplier table 1.2/1.4/1.6/3.2 by stars; 24 with the base ATK 15 and no ATK changes), then, unless the target holds a Twist Band, requests -10 speed on the target and +10 speed on the caster (both scaled by the caster's AP and by crit; the steal happens even if the damage killed the target). The two speed changes are applied independently, so they need not be equal.

targeting.who: the cast target only (speed gain on the caster)
targeting.note: No geometry beyond the target the caster already has; the damage and steal are both applied to the cast target and the caster.

geometry.shape: single target, no area, no movement

declaredRaw.label: requested damage multiplier of the caster's current ATK

effects.scaling: requested = Math.round(caster.atk x table[stars-1]) using the caster's current atk (buffs/debuffs included, not the catalog base). handleSpecialDamage then: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT on either side; x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so only with ABILITY_CRIT).
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1, shield absorbs first; takenDamage (not stored by this strategy) = shield damage + HP damage, 0 for protect / skydiving / magicBounce. With the catalog base ATK 15 and no ATK change the requested value is 24 (illustration of the formula, not a combat claim).

effects.target: the cast target (-10) and the caster (+10)
effects.scaling: both calls use apBoost 1 and the cast crit flag: value x (1 + AP/100) x (critPower if the cast crit), not rounded. The caster's call first goes through applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff: a Big Eater Belt holder's +10 becomes 12 (x1.25, rounded down to 0 digits) before AP/crit scaling. The target's -10 gets no Big Eater Belt effect (the caster is on the other team, the helper only touches positive values or negative values from a same-team caster). applyTwistBandBuff does not change the caster's positive value; a target holding Twist Band skips both changes (explicit guard).
effects.resolution: applied change = new speed clamped to [0, 300]: the target cannot go below 0, so a target with less than the requested speed loses less than the caster gains; the caster cannot exceed 300. A MELMETAL-passive holder on either side gets half the (post-helper) value as ATTACK change (via addAttack) instead of any speed change, so its speed does not move. Not permanent (only the combat entity changes).

starBehavior.note: Only the damage multiplier depends on stars (index stars-1 of the caster). The speed amount is star-independent. 1.2, 1.4 and 3.2 are not reachable by the listed 3-star units at their bare factory stars.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP. Speed changes are cumulative across casts within a fight up to the clamp and are not undone by the strategy.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage = round(ATK x 1.6); speed -10 on the target and +10 on the caster. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional DOUBLE_DAMAGE / steam / crit multipliers, then SPE_DEF division, round up and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage and is not used by the strategy. Applied speed = requested x (1 + AP/100) x crit (unrounded), Big Eater Belt x1.25 down on the caster's gain, then clamped to [0, 300] on each side; none for a Twist Band target; attack instead of speed for a MELMETAL holder.
